scope: Independent read-only Codex review of recruitment Core/server source and isolated file-backend HTTP verification of both P2 integrity fixes.

evidenceOrigin.kind: completed tool execution output in this audit chat
evidenceOrigin.note: This file packages the completed review and the observed sanitized output; it is not a newly run test or a pre-existing raw log.

resolvedFindings.issue: Unchecked recruitment receipt body could return a known result different from the Core-replayed ledger and expose injected nested private members.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Validate reconstructs the exact historical reply from the Core-replayed ledger prefix via shared ReplyText; stored bytes must match.

resolvedFindings.issue: An absent recruitment member with success receipts retained was accepted as a fresh recruitment account and permitted a new launch claim.
resolvedFindings.resolution: CheckEnvelope runs unconditionally and requires non-run receipts to have corresponding recruitment ledger entries.

httpRecheck.host: real rebuilt MemoryForge.Server process, Development, ephemeral loopback address
httpRecheck.store: fresh owner-only temporary store and generated test-only fixture; removed after verification
httpRecheck.tamperMethod: Independently modify a copy of the committed envelope and recompute its outer SHA-256; receipt identity and HTTP status remain unchanged except the explicit invalid-status case.
tamperRequests: POST /dev/practice/recruitment/pulls with the original committed requestId and exact original payload
POST /dev/practice/recruitment/pulls with a fresh requestId and current revision
POST /dev/practice/recruitment/claim-launch with a fresh requestId and current revision

tamperCaseDetails.known_result_and_receipt_history: Change the first pull receipt result ID and its snapshot history result ID to another known ID from the same result pool.
tamperCaseDetails.nested_private_field: Insert results[0].draws = [[10000,7]] into the stored public receipt body.
tamperCaseDetails.recruitment_removed_receipts_kept: Remove only the recruitment member; retain both recruitment success receipts and the interleaved run receipt.
tamperCaseDetails.historical_wallet: Increase the stored pull receipt snapshot wallet freeCrystals by 160.
tamperCaseDetails.malformed_receipt: Replace the stored pull receipt body with malformed JSON.
tamperCaseDetails.bad_receipt_status: Change the stored pull receipt HTTP status from 200 to 422.

normalControls: Fresh account recruitment GET returns200 with launchClaimed false.
Launch claim at revision0 commits revision1; one standard pull at revision1 commits revision2.
Interleaved run creation commits successfully; next standard pull at revision3 commits revision4, preserving a legitimate recruitment ledger revision gap.
Original claim, first pull, later pull and run requests return byte-identical committed replies; retries leave stored bytes unchanged.
After killing and restarting the isolated host, the original first pull still returns its exact committed reply.
Re-digested but otherwise unchanged envelope is accepted; GET matches the committed snapshot and exact retry returns original bytes without rewriting the envelope.
Restoring intact bytes restores the exact original retry.
Intact current-revision repeat launch claim returns422 LAUNCH_ALREADY_CLAIMED.
Intact stale fresh pull returns409 STALE_REVISION.
